dom.introText:
5
Wet sand

Wet sand is darker, with a drop and a number on it. It only goes onto sand of its own colour, never into an empty jar. Every pour on the board dries it a little: at 0 it is ordinary sand. A full jar seals once its sand is dry.
labels201: Jar 2: buried; buried; sage; wet terracotta, dries in 5 pours
Jar 10: buried; buried; wet plum, dries in 5 pours; cocoa
craftedLabels: Jar 1: terracotta; terracotta; wet terracotta, dries in 2 pours; wet terracotta, dries in 3 pours (full, seals when dry)
Jar 3: sage; lagoon; wet sage, dries in 4 pours
Jar 4: lagoon; sage; wet lagoon, dries after the next pour
dom.toast: Wet sand only goes onto its own colour.
